title: The Cinderheart Foundry
theme: Volcanic forge-temple with cracked stone, old lava channels, and ritual metalwork
hook: A red glow has returned beneath the abandoned mountain foundry. Each night, villagers hear hammers striking under the stone, though the forge has been cold for a generation.
background: The foundry was once a forge-temple where smith-priests cooled sacred metal in lava-fed channels. A sealed ember heart has cracked open, waking constructs, hungry fire spirits, and old oaths buried in slag.

connections.note: Concealed ash-service crawl behind the slag shelves

playerSafe.description: A black-stone forge ruin with safe walkways, visible forge halls, and dangerous glowing lava channels left unmarked.

layout.notes: Lava-shaped forge complex with basalt platforms, grate crossings, service ledges, and hazard-separated work zones.

rooms.name: Ashfall Gate
rooms.readAloud: Black grit drifts from the vaulted entry like snow. A cracked bronze gate hangs open, warm enough to sting bare fingers.
rooms.gmNotes: The gate records vows spoken while passing through it. A false promise causes embers to flare in Room 2.

inhabitants.name: Cinder Vermin
inhabitants.tactics: Surge from ash piles, scatter through cracks, harry anyone carrying food or oil
inhabitants.morale: Flee from cold water or loud hammer strikes
inhabitants.wants: Warm nests and scraps of charred fat
inhabitants.leverage: Can be distracted with salt, ash cakes, or cold metal

rooms.treasure: A bronze entry token stamped with a hammer and flame.
rooms.secrets: A soot pattern near the gate shows the foundry was sealed from inside, not abandoned.
rooms.exits: Cooled switchback to Room 2, service ledge to Room 8.

rooms.name: Slag Shelf Gallery
rooms.readAloud: Shelves of glassy slag line the walls. Some pieces glow from within, pulsing like banked coals.
rooms.gmNotes: The slag shelves hide an ash-service crawl to Room 8. Breaking glowing slag releases a burst of choking heat.
rooms.treasure: A thumb-sized ingot of heat-dark metal wrapped in cracked tongs.
rooms.secrets: A concealed ash-service crawl behind the slag shelves drops toward Room 8.
rooms.exits: Cooled switchback to Room 1, slag bridge to Room 3, concealed ash-service crawl to Room 8.

rooms.name: Great Anvil Nave
rooms.readAloud: A broad forge chamber hangs over three glowing lava cuts. Huge anvils sit like altar stones on blackened platforms.
rooms.gmNotes: This is the map anchor: a large central work zone split by heat and reachable from several directions. Striking the central anvil in the old rhythm calms one construct encounter or reveals the right route through heat shimmer.

inhabitants.name: Ashbound Forge Constructs
inhabitants.tactics: Hold bridges, push intruders near hot cracks, obey forge-bell rhythms
inhabitants.morale: Stand down if the proper work rhythm is repeated
inhabitants.wants: The foundry returned to lawful work
inhabitants.leverage: Recognize smith marks, entry tokens, and correct hammer cadence

rooms.treasure: A balanced forge hammer that never loses its edge against cooled metal.
rooms.secrets: The anvils ring differently near the path to the ember heart.
rooms.exits: Slag bridge to Room 2, grate crossing to Room 4, furnace drop to Room 5.

rooms.name: Magma Sluice Bridge
rooms.readAloud: A narrow bridge crosses a glowing channel. Heat shimmer bends the far arch into impossible angles.
rooms.gmNotes: The bridge is safe if crossed slowly. Running or fighting near the edge risks a dangerous stumble toward the lava channel.

inhabitants.name: Cinder-Wing Spirits
inhabitants.tactics: Dart from heat shimmer, bait movement, vanish over lava
inhabitants.morale: Dim if ash is scattered over the channel
inhabitants.leverage: Can be bargained with using bellows, vents, or promised release

rooms.treasure: A cracked obsidian bridge token that marks safe footing through heat shimmer.
rooms.secrets: The channel once carried sacred lava, but the current flow is leaking from a broken seal.
rooms.exits: Grate crossing to Room 3, bellows ladder to Room 7.

rooms.name: Quenching Cistern
rooms.readAloud: A dry cistern yawns beneath cracked pipes. Steam hisses from seams where old water met living fire.
rooms.gmNotes: Restoring water flow weakens the ember heart but creates heavy steam that obscures routes for a scene. This lower work zone connects the safe paths around the central lava break.

inhabitants.name: Steam-Bitten Oozes
inhabitants.tactics: Slide from pipe shadows, split around obstacles, avoid open flame
inhabitants.morale: Retreat into drains if cooled or salted
inhabitants.leverage: Can be lured with wet stone dust

rooms.treasure: A sealed ceramic flask of old quenching salts.
rooms.secrets: A cracked pipe points toward the hidden ash-service system in Room 8.
rooms.exits: Furnace drop to Room 3, crucible causeway to Room 6, lower service path to Room 8.

rooms.name: Cinderheart Crucible
rooms.readAloud: A cracked crucible glows in the center of a circular chamber. The light inside beats slowly, like a heart under stone.
rooms.gmNotes: The finale can be solved by cooling, re-binding, or bargaining with the ember heart. Destroying it outright risks a violent surge.

inhabitants.name: The Ember Heart
inhabitants.tactics: Pulse heat through cracks, animate tools, bargain through forge echoes
inhabitants.morale: Accepts binding if the old smith-priest vow is completed
inhabitants.wants: Purpose, fuel, and release from the broken seal
inhabitants.leverage: It remembers honorable craft and responds to promises of useful work

rooms.treasure: A cinderheart shard, the foundry charter, and the right to reclaim the forge safely.
rooms.secrets: The ember heart was not stolen; it was trapped after refusing to make weapons for a tyrant.
rooms.exits: Crucible causeway to Room 5, cooled service vent back to the mountain path.

rooms.name: Bellows Control Loft
rooms.readAloud: A high iron platform overlooks the sluice. Split bellows hang from chains, breathing warm air whenever the lava below pulses.
rooms.gmNotes: The bellows can redirect heat from one route for a scene. A careful party can make Room 4 safer or vent smoke away from Room 3.

inhabitants.name: Bellows-Bound Minder
inhabitants.tactics: Uses vents to shove smoke, split the party with heat, and demand proper workshop etiquette
inhabitants.morale: Cooperates if given a clear repair task
inhabitants.wants: A completed shift order and someone to oil the chain wheels
inhabitants.leverage: Respects workers who speak plainly and carry the entry token

rooms.treasure: A vent key fused to an iron chain and a brass pressure gauge still warm to the touch.
rooms.secrets: One bellows mark identifies which furnace duct leads toward the crucible seal.
rooms.exits: Bellows ladder to Room 4, vent shutters to outside air.

rooms.name: Collapsed Service Vent
rooms.readAloud: A cramped ledge bends behind broken furnace brick. Ash slides through a narrow vent, and a faint red line glows below the stones.
rooms.gmNotes: This area makes the map feel like a service network rather than a straight room chain. The secret crawl to Room 2 is tight but safe if the party moves slowly.
rooms.treasure: A packet of old forge chalk used to mark safe footing near heat cracks.
rooms.secrets: A concealed ash-service crawl rises to Room 2 behind a slag shelf.
rooms.exits: Service ledge to Room 1, lower service path to Room 5, concealed ash-service crawl to Room 2.

complications.result: A safe walkway shakes but does not collapse if crossed calmly

gmNotes: Keep safe walkways visually and narratively distinct from lava channels.
The forge is dangerous, but many threats respond to craft, rhythm, and honest vows.
The twist is that the ember heart was imprisoned for refusing tyrant work.
A strong ending leaves the foundry cooled, re-bound, or repurposed rather than simply looted.
